description: A Roman numeral converter — numbers to numerals, and numerals back to numbers. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

numeral.description: Either a Roman numeral ("MCMXCIV") or a whole number from 1 to 3999 ("1994"); the direction is worked out from what is given. Loose forms like IIII are read and reported with strict false, and the strict modern spelling is returned alongside.

name: roman_numerals
title: Roman Numerals
